title: Chi l’ha vista morire?
scene: Italian giallo; Venetian choral film score
notes: Venetian children’s songs become unnerving polyphony over harpsichord, electric bass and drums.

title: Revolver
notes: Beretta’s French vocal contrasts with relentless piano-led orchestral pursuit music and gentler themes.

title: La proprietà non è più un furto
scene: Elio Petri’s Italian political and satirical cinema
notes: Grotesque marches and unsettling vocal textures evoke an oppressive city obsessed with possession.

title: Il mio nome è Nessuno
scene: Italian comic western; early-1970s post-Leone western
notes: Playful western themes and epic flourishes mix whistling, guitar, choir and a Wagner quotation.
